controls_note: A pass that denies every host it probes cannot distinguish 'these hosts are denied' from 'the probe is broken'. The reachable control answering 200 is what separates them.
method: Two HTTPS GETs per host through this environment's egress proxy, redirects not followed, descriptive user-agent, 20s timeout, verdict classified on the response body rather than the status code. Read-only; no credential, no account, nothing published, no spend.

results.why_unindexed: Named in portfolio/ledger/asks.yaml's egress-policy ask, so the account owner is asked to allowlist it. Measured by #232, which recorded 23 hosts in prose and left no results file, so --ingest could never see it.

The host that actually serves the EUVD API; euvd.enisa.europa.eu, the host the ask names, serves only the website. Probed 2026-08-23 by a pass living under portfolio/pipeline/probes/, outside this walk's tree.

why_this_file_exists: consolidate.py --ingest walks portfolio/research/ for machine-readable results files. A host measured in prose, or measured by a pass living outside that tree, is invisible to it -- and because --probe iterates the table --ingest builds, an invisible host is also never re-measured. These two were invisible on both counts. Each record names, in `source`, the document that first measured it; the verdict fields are this pass's own re-measurement, taken with probe_host() so the body-based classification rule this directory established applies.
